## Current PM

⏳ **vacant**, signed off 2026-10-31 at 09:55Z on the maintainer's word 「UI 车道下班，开 server 车道」 (09:43Z, in the `os-tesla` account's Claude project). Previous holder: `os-tesla`, session `session_01L9qibz8HEj53Wx2uphTo2o`, seated 2026-10-30T14:23Z. The sign-off brief is the newest comment on this post. To take over, run `/pm-dispatch 接手` and read this post first.

## Handover ledger

- **In flight:** none. Every PR this tenure dispatched has merged: #28193, #28197, #28227, #28254 (10-30); #28293 (#28179), #28312 (#28164), #28310 (#28241), #28296 (#28239), #28329 (#28240), #28334 (#28102), #28360 (#28194), #28361 (#28135) (10-31). Each card carries a landing note.
- **Released:** #28148 (N-04 under epic #28236): Release 6541889272 + 6541903860, `needs-user-decision` (the maintainer's 10-30 pause is unanswered), `Resume-from: claude/project-thread-dhj1ou@1a9e7703`.
- **Decision inbox (maintainer):** #28148 resume (above). #27356 rows 1/4/6/8 were screened out as feature proposals and row 10 is will-not-do; whether to card them was asked of the maintainer and is unanswered.
- **Findings filed this tenure:** #28220 (`domain:devx`, ui test shards skipped for `ui_consumers`-only diffs), #28333 (`domain:devx`, the Vite dev Console cannot import `@objectstack/lint`).
- **Queue snapshot (domain:ui, 09:55Z):** no free, dispatchable card in seat 3's area. #27975 is `pm:retriage`; #27521 is seat 1's; #27058 and #27059 are under `pm:epic` #26676; #28158 is blocked by #27944; #28118 is blocked by #28117 + #28318. The P1/P2 Studio cards of epic #28236 are cut after N-01 #28237 merges, which the maintainer merges by hand.
- **Cross-lane note:** #28194 and #28135 (`domain:server`) were taken under 「你有空你就可以派」. The maintainer then ruled (06:04Z): in-progress cards finish, no new cross-lane takes. Both have landed.

## Hot-file serial queue

- **This seat holds:** nothing. ⛔ Re-derive from the live `Claim:` comments and each open PR's file list before every dispatch.
- **File area (for the next holder):** Studio: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/**` and the other Studio views and pages under `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/**`, `ui/packages/plugin-designer`, `ui/packages/plugin-editor`, and the i18n `studio` namespace. AI chat: `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot`. Tooling: `ui/scripts/**`. End-to-end: `ui/e2e/**`.
- **Excluded:** the `pm:epic` subtrees (#8345 multi-currency, #26676 record page). `ui/.github/**` and the root `ci.yml` stay ⛔ out of bounds for ui cards.

## Notes

- **Standing constraints (maintainer):** changesets for ui cards go to the root `.changeset/`. No PR on the objectui repository. `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` gates every ui card. A PR that needs the maintainer's approval gets `os-zhuang` requested as reviewer after the seat ACCEPT and a same-head contract PASS. Seats self-review at the contract tier and land PRs they ACCEPTed. Up to 5 card threads per seat. Seats coordinate within this project's spec and ui seats only, never other lanes (06:04Z).
- **Mailbox:** #28155, closed at sign-off. The next holder reopens one per seat.
- **Publication:** a merge to `main` publishes nothing. The release is the Version Packages PR, which a human merges.
- **Wall:** none.
